paite: Dal maitam, adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asandan tong sawm abawl hi.
heading: Tempul Vanzatte / (1 Kum 7.23-51)
english: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

paite: Dal lohbem lianpi, agei leh agei kikal a tong sawm kia, asandan tong nga abawl a; agei akimvel in tong sawmthum ahi.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

paite: Agei nuai bawngtal limte in avelsuak a, tong khat ah sawm zel, dal loh kimvel in a-om hi. Bawngtal limte vual nih ahi a, dal loh akimat a sun ahi.
english: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

paite: Huchi in bel bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uh; dal loh bel huaite tung ah akoih a, anunglam anga hi.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

paite: Loh pen khutpek tan in asah a, agei ahihleh nou gei bangbang, lili pak bang a bawl ahi a, bath sangthum ta ahi.
english: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

paite: Kisilna ding kuangzawn, sawm abawl lai a, taklam sang ah nga atung a, veilam sang ah nga atung a; huaite bel halmang thillat silna ding ahi; huan, dal lohbem bel siampute kisilna ding ahi.
english: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

paite: Huan bawldan ding a aseh bang in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sawm abawl a, tempul sung taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih hi.
english: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

paite: Dohkan sawm abawl lai a, tempul sung ah taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih a, dangka-eng kuangzawn zakhat abawl hi.
english: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

paite: Huai lou leng siampute huang leh huang zapite a-um a, huang kongkhakte abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

paite: Loh pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simdoh in atung hi.
english: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

paite: Huram in belte, vutluahnate, kuangzawnte abawl hi. Huchi in Pathian inn a ding a kumpipa Solomon abawlsak Huram in azouta hi.
english: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

paite: Khuam nihte, noubemte khuam dawn a zing nihte, khuam dawn a noubem nihte tuamna gial chitek nihte;
english: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

paite: huai tuamna gial chitek nih ding a theibuhfai zalite khuam dawn a noubial nih tuamna ding gial chitek tuaktuak ding a theibuhfai vual nihte.
english: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

paite: Kingaknate, kingakna tung a kuangzawnte leng abawl a;
english: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

paite: Loh khat leh anuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte toh.
english: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

paite: Belte, vutluahnate, sa thuknate leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leng Huram in TOUPA' inn a dia dal nawttet akumpipa Solomon abawlsak ahi.
english: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for Yahweh’s house, of bright bronze.

paite: Huaite Jordan Phaizang ah Sukoth leh Zered bellei mun ah kumpipa'n asung hi.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

paite: Huchibang in Solomon in tui-um belsuan tampi abawl a; dal gikzah buk seng vual ahi kei hi.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

paite: Solomon in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a, dangka-eng maitamte, tanghou koihna dohkante.
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

paite: Seh bang a mun siangthou mai adet ding khawnvak koihnate, akhawnvak nangawn toh, dangka-eng ngen in abawl hi.
english: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

paite: Dangka-eng pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte, dangka-eng siang ngen in abawl hi.
english: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

paite: Khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute, mei laknate dangka-eng siang ngen mah in; huan, insung lutna, insung gilzaw Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh a-inn, tempul kongkhakte dangka-eng in abawl hi.
english: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
